note: Private test IPA 744 (the maintainer's request of 14 November 2026, after the IPA 737 logs: finish the heat and energy points left untouched, then an IPA to measure them): the verified IPA 743 product with RPCS3 Core 938 in place of Core 936. Core 937: the 100 us wait of a polling GETLLAR follows the self-validating idle backoff (35,000 to 38,000 of the 48,000 timer wakeups a second of the Black Ops II menus). Core 938: 1 ms RSX park slices after 250 ms of FIFO idle (16,600 wakeups a second during a freeze) and the SPU local stores of a 20 s busy freeze written beside the journals (RPCS3-freeze-spu.bin) to read the Black Ops II job code. Every other engine, Core and retained component is that of the base. Build-only delivery: Flutter/native groups are not run. Nothing has run on an iPhone; no heat, energy or FPS claim.
